short: The share of customers who stop buying from you.
seoTitle: Churn Rate — Meaning, Formula and Example
metaDescription: Churn rate is the percentage of customers who stop buying over a period. Churn compounds quietly. The share of customers who stop buying from you.
definition: Churn rate is the percentage of customers who stop buying over a period. For subscription businesses it is measurable directly; for retail and restaurants it is inferred from the absence of repeat purchases.
bodyHtml:
Why Churn Rate matters

Churn compounds quietly. Losing 5% of customers a month means replacing the entire base within two years just to stand still.

Churn Rate formula

Churn rate % = Customers lost in period ÷ Customers at start of period × 100

Retention rate is simply 100 minus churn.

How Churn Rate works in practice

Define churn against your natural purchase cycle — no purchase in ninety days means something different for a cafe than for a jeweller. Then look at what the churned cohort had in common.

faq.question: How is churn measured in a restaurant?
faq.answer: By absence of repeat visits within a defined window, which is why capturing customer identity at billing matters.

faq.question: Is some churn unavoidable?
faq.answer: Yes. People move and habits change; what matters is churn you can influence, such as service failures.
